component.name: Lector
component.summary: Fast, reading-first code viewer and git review tool

description.p: Lector is built for reading and reviewing code rather than typing it: understanding an unfamiliar codebase, following definitions, and reviewing changes made by people or AI agents. It never modifies your files or repositories.

ul.li: Tree-sitter highlighting, sticky scroll, breadcrumbs, outline and symbol search
Go to definition, references and hover via language servers or built-in tags
Side-by-side and unified diffs, review checklists, history graph and blame
Fuzzy file finder, project search, Markdown and image preview

description.p: First release: a complete read-only reader and git review tool.
